title: Retry Transient
statement: Implement `solve(attempts, tag, limit)`. `attempts` is a list of result tags in order. Retry only while the tag equals `tag`, and stop after `limit` tries. Return the first tag that is not the retryable one, or the last tag you actually tried if every try was retryable. `limit` is the maximum number of attempts, not the number of extra retries.
constraints: limit is at least 1 in the successful-path tests, and may be 0
A limit of 0 returns the string error
hints: If limit is less than 1, return error.
Walk attempts, but never more than limit of them.
Return immediately when the tag is not the retryable tag.

approaches.name: Direct
approaches.explanation: A retry decorator that retries every exception will retry a ValueError the caller caused.

editorial: A retry decorator that retries every exception will retry a ValueError the caller caused. Filtering on one tag, and capping the attempts, is the policy. The returned tag is the one the caller would observe: the first permanent result, or the final transient failure if the budget ends there.
